title: The Uli Dataset: An Exercise in Experience Led Annotation of oGBV
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset for online gender-based violence (oGBV) detection. While it emphasizes ethical considerations in its participatory data creation methodology and addresses biases in language, it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary research subject. Its 'ethical considerations' are part of the dataset creation process, not the core topic of evaluation.
